accommodation.branch_A: Pilinski altitude prior, both activity columns
accommodation.factorial_isotherm_temperature_conventio: AMBIENT freestream neutral temperature, per the published partial-pressure form P_O = n_AO T_inf (R / M_AO); held FIXED across all eight factorial corners, so the A axis varies n_O alone and does not couple to the composition axis

ao_dual_role.note: direct role: O's own momentum flux and drag-force share; indirect role: O changing the AO-conditioned accommodation of ALL species (the factorial accommodation main effect and its interactions). Never combined into one unlabelled number.

atmosphere_models.wam_ipe: total density only in this archive product; hybrid labelled WAM_IPE_total_density_with_NRLMSIS_composition_sensitivity

flow_convention.wind: u_wind = 0 labelled baseline; parametric envelope in wind_sensitivity.csv

geometry.assumption_status: Starlink-LIKE public-data proxy: every dimension is a round-number assumption representing the publicly reported vehicle class (flat-panel bus, single large array), NOT SpaceX data, NOT the proprietary geometry; per-mass quantities anchor to the operator-published inverse ballistic coefficient, not to an assumed mass-area pairing
geometry.name: Starlink-like public-data proxy geometry

git_commit_note: HEAD when this run executed; outputs and generator are committed together as its child

kernels.uncertainty: cll (Walker-Mehta-Koller closed form; alpha_N x sigma_T swept; unsupported species excluded and reported)

mass_note: event nominal mass; per-mass quantities also anchored to the operator-published inverse ballistic coefficient in the scalar branch
